notes:
Topline: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (customer-facing insights widgets). Started hosted API trial 2024-11-20; moving to Dedicated evaluation for throughput and residency. Team is product-led; engineering-heavy sales cycle. High sensitivity to per-token cost but cannot sacrifice p95 latency > 350ms for interactive features.

Key contacts: CTO - Nina Patel (technical decision), Head of ML - Arjun Mehta (POC owner), VP Product - Sophie Lang (budget approver). AE: Maya Chen; SE: Diego Ramos.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2024-11-20: Hosted API trial kickoff (dev keys issued).
- 2024-12-02: Initial integration spike: embeddings for doc search + chat UI. Observed cold-start p95 ~ 480ms; warm p95 ~ 230ms. Logged to shared Drive (hosted-trial-results-2024-12.pdf).
- 2024-12-10: Security questionnaire submitted (SAML, SOC2). Security call with Redwood SecOps - action item: KMS integration mapping.
- 2024-12-18: Hosted trial usage review — daily peak QPS ~ 3.6, 99th percentile concurrency bursts to 28 (30m window). Token mix: ~62% short responses (avg 40-120 tokens), ~28% medium (300-800 tokens), ~10% long (>800 tokens) used during nightly summarization jobs.
- 2025-01-06: Feature demo for execs (Sophie, Nina). Execs asked about Dedicated pricing and committed throughput guarantees.
- 2025-01-12: Deep-dive with SE (Diego): discuss autoscale options, cache/kv prefix strategies, routing to cheaper quantized variants for non-interactive jobs. Fireflies notes: "We need predictable p95 for widgets — can't have variability during launches."
- 2025-01-20: Internal infra review — request from Copperlode to size Dedicated pool and provide traffic forecast template for finance.

POC / Sizing notes (observed -> recommended):
- Observed hosted-trial baseline: avg QPS 1.8, peak QPS 3.6, steady-state concurrency 10-16, burst concurrency to 28. Token mix above. Average tokens per request (weighted): ~220 tokens.
- Service-level goal: p95 generation latency <= 350ms for chat/widget interactive calls; nightly batch jobs acceptable at higher latency.
- Recommended Dedicated baseline for POC: 4 x A100-equivalent instances (reserved for customer) with continuous batching tuned to preserve latency SLO. Expected headroom for 50% growth. Config: 8-10 concurrent request slots per instance, KV cache for top-10k prefixes, 2-3 quantized model variants for rerouting low-priority traffic.
- Forecast assumptions to present to finance: baseline QPS 4 (peak 6), average concurrency target 20, monthly token mix 70% interactive (short-medium) / 30% backend summarization (long). Monthly token volume estimate: 120M tokens.
- Cost sensitivity: Copperlode pushes back at per-token pricing > $0.003 for hosted-like usage; looking for committed discount on Dedicated with overage cap.

Security/compliance:
- Requirement list: SSO (SAML/Okta), SOC2 attestation, audit logs retention 12 months, KMS integration for key management, EU data residency for subset of EU customers.
- Blocker: On-prem network team needs VPC peering diagram and list of IP ranges; Redwood provided draft network diagram (drive link).

Sales/contracting:
- Copperlode is willing to commit to 12-month Dedicated contract if pricing meets ARR expectations and SLAs include p95 latency and capacity scaling clauses. Forecast close: target MARCH 2025.

Next steps (short):
- (SE) Diego to provision a Dedicated POC estimate and configuration doc by 2025-01-24.
- (AE) Maya to schedule final pricing call with CFO/VP Product week of 2025-01-27.
- (Security) Share final KMS integration plan and IP ranges; ask Copperlode infra to sign the network diagram.

Notes from parkside call: "If we can lock predictable p95 and a committed price with protection against token spikes, we can move to Dedicated this quarter."
